title: Designer Tribute Zine

card.teaser: An eight-page folded zine and a quote poster for designer Jonathan Castro.

summary: An eight-page folded zine and a quote poster celebrating designer Jonathan Castro.

hero.alt: A folded, brightly coloured zine about Jonathan Castro.

overview.challenge: Celebrate Jonathan Castro's way of working: emotional energy, layered references and a lot of experimenting.
overview.solution: Layered, expressive spreads that unfold across eight folded pages, plus a poster that boils the idea down to one statement.
overview.outcome: Two related pieces: a compact zine that builds page by page, and a poster about design, process and meaning piling up.

blocks.label: Why Jonathan Castro
blocks.text: I was drawn to his vibrant colors, chaotic compositions, and the way he draws inspiration from his Latin culture. That is something I deeply connect with.

blocks.label: Research
blocks.heading: Looking closely at Jonathan Castro.
blocks.body: I studied his work to see what makes it his: vibrant color, chaotic compositions, and references pulled from his Latin culture.
blocks.caption: Research.

blocks.label: Sketches
blocks.heading: Working out the layout.
blocks.body: Early sketches tested how the zine could unfold across eight folded pages, with each spread layering a little more than the last.
blocks.caption: Sketches and early layouts.

blocks.label: Concept
blocks.heading: Piles of process and meaning.
blocks.body: The concept came together as layers building on layers. The zine builds page by page, and the poster boils the same idea down to one statement.
blocks.alt: Concept development for the zine and poster.
blocks.caption: Concept development.

blocks.label: Final
blocks.alt: Grid of the final zine pages and poster.
blocks.caption: The final zine and poster, side by side.
